item.title: Morocco Fast-Tracks Land Seizures for New Casablanca–Rabat Highway and High-Speed Rail Expansion
item.description: This issue of the Official Gazette clears land for a new Casablanca-Rabat highway and expanding high-speed rail lines, reshapes the Bouregreg riverbanks in Rabat-Salé, and cancels two unused aquaculture concessions near Dakhla while licensing a new one near Sidi Ifni.

item.title: Morocco Opens 12 New Offshore Oil Blocks to Foreign Drillers
item.description: Morocco’s Bulletin Officiel n°7510: 12 new offshore oil blocks for foreign drillers, butane gas margin changes, a telecom fiber-sharing deal, plus aquaculture licenses and medical diploma recognitions.

item.title: Six Moroccan Lawmakers Quit in Ten Days — Constitutional Court Declares Seats Vacant
item.description: Six Moroccan MPs resigned in ten days, the Constitutional Court moved fast to fill the gap, foreign-trained doctors got new equivalency routes, and three companies were licensed to farm shrimp, oysters and fish along the coast.
